description: Bad Liebenwerda: Strassenachsen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gdi-bb.gajamatrix.de. Street axes of the city of Bad Liebenwerda. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Bad Liebenwerda: Road axes" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WMS, GDI, Ressource. The listing shows 2016-04-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
